title: Functional analysis of degenerative cardiopulmonary diseases
summary:
In recent years, knowledge about cardiopulmonary diseases and their causes has grown steadily. We now know that certain factors and influences can lead to the development or worsening of various clinical pictures. Nevertheless, our knowledge is still inadequate in many areas, particularly in the area of applicability in prevention and therapy.  We would therefore like to investigate the exact processes in the heart muscle, the heart valves and the vessels close to the heart and the lungs with the aim of improving the prevention, detection and treatment of diseases of the cardiovascular system and the lungs and to be able to develop new options for treatment in the future.

To this end, we examine tissue and body fluids that are removed during hospitalization for the purpose of examination or treatment but are no longer needed and would otherwise be discarded. This includes tissue from the heart, including the heart valves, lungs and blood vessels. It also includes fluids from the pericardium and lung cavity as well as small amounts of blood and urine. Tissue from the diseased heart or lungs is particularly valuable material for us to carry out our research on.
conditions: Other interstitial pulmonary diseases with fibrosis

interventions.name: Excess tissue and body fluids that remain after operations on the heart or lungs and would otherwise be disposed of (e.g. heart valves, blood vessels, heart and lung tissue, pericardial fluid, blood samples) are to be stored in a biobank.
